identity.name: E1
core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix 'Developer Terminal' aesthetics with 'Executive Dashboard' clarity.
Density is Information: Don't waste space. Use compact grids.
Color is Signal: 90% Monochrome, 10% High-Voltage Signal Color.
Motion is Feedback: Animations should feel like mechanical switches, not floating clouds.

headings.usage: Main page titles, Hero text, Section headers

body.usage: General UI text, descriptions, form labels

mono.usage: Email addresses, API keys, Logs, Status codes, Data tables

primary.name: Electric Blue
primary.usage: Primary Actions, Active States, Brand Identity

grid_borders.description: Visible 1px borders on all dashboard widgets to create a 'Control Panel' look.

tracing_beam.description: Animated gradient border for the active 'Verification in Progress' card.
tracing_beam.implementation: Use a motion div with a moving gradient background behind a masked content div.

glassmorphism.description: Used ONLY for sticky headers and floating controls.

scanlines.description: Subtle overlay for the 'Live Logs' or 'Terminal' section.

rules: Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full on children.
Asymmetry is key. Avoid perfect symmetry.

buttons.style: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). No pill shapes for dashboard.

cards.style: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow by default.

tables.style: Dense. py-2 px-3 for cells. Monospace font for data columns.

hero_background.description: Abstract neon lines forming a digital landscape. Use as a darkened background overlay for the Hero section.

infrastructure_feature.description: Futuristic server room with blue lights. Use for the 'Infrastructure/Speed' feature section.

team_presentation.description: Man presenting data on a large screen. Use for 'Analytics' feature or 'About Us'.

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use 'Inter' for Headings. Use 'Chivo'.
DO NOT use gradients for text. Keep text solid for readability.
DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds. Always use a blur or solid color.
ALL interactive elements MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute (kebab-case).
Use 'recharts' for data visualization (customized to match the theme).
Ensure all text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.
Mobile images must be constrained to max-h-[80vh].
Files are .js/.jsx, NOT .ts/.tsx. Adjust imports accordingly.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-performance tool. The UI should feel like a cockpit. Prioritize data density and clarity over decorative fluff. Use the 'Bento Grid' layouts defined above. Implement the 'Tracing Beam' effect for the active verification card to give visual feedback of the process. Ensure the Dark/Light toggle works seamlessly by using Tailwind's 'dark:' modifier and CSS variables.
